Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
This is an application for bail.

The appellant-petitioner has been convicted under section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay a fine of Rs.10,000/- (rupees ten thousand), in default of payment of fine, to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a further period of one year by the learned Sessions Judge, Cuttack in S.T. Case No.324 of 2016.

Learned counsel for the State has produced the report of the Officer in-charge of Baideswar police station, which indicates that during the period of interim bail, the petitioner has not misutilized his liberty.
The report is taken on record.

sentences.text:
Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that that the petitioner is in judicial custody for eight years out of ten years of substantive sentence imposed on him by the learned trial Court and twice he has been granted interim bail and after availing the same, he surrendered at right time and there is no chance of early hearing of the appeal in the near future and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Let the appellant-petitioner be released on bail pending disposal of the appeal on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (rupees twenty thousand) with one local solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA Judge RKMAuthentication
